title: Blowing up the r-th Fitting ideal makes a module finite locally free of rank r on a scheme theoretically dense open
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a finitely presented module which is finite locally free of constant rank on a scheme theoretically dense open, blowing up the r-th Fitting ideal is admissible over that open, makes the strict transform locally free of rank r, and exhibits the pullback as an extension of that strict transform by a finitely presented kernel supported on the exceptional divisor, with a tor dimension bound (statement lines 9339-9356). The counted proof is a short but complete argument: it checks admissibility from the finite typeness of the Fitting ideal and its value on the open, uses scheme theoretic density to conclude that the lower Fitting ideal vanishes on the whole scheme, which is what makes the module finite locally free off the Fitting subscheme, applies the strict transform statement, and reads off the statements about the kernel and the tor dimension (proof lines 9358-9397). It is H2: every step is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard Fitting ideal and Tor statements.
